0.3.3.name: CoshStyling
0.3.3.description: The object that holds a Node's style values.

background_color.description: Takes in an RGB (or RGBA) value and sets the color of the Node's background.

alpha.description: Takes in an integer value between 0 and 255 and sets the opacity of the Node and the children within it.

border.description: Takes in a color value and a weight value in this format (`((255, 255, 255), 5)` or `(255, 255, 255, 5)`) and renders an outline around the Node.

border_radius.description: Curves a Nodes corners, taking in a tuple or int value in this format `(top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left)` or just an integer to determine the radius.

transform_position.description: Offsets the Node's render position by the position value given.

transform_scale.description: Scales the Node's size in render based on the scalar value given.

transform_rotation.description: Rotates the Node based on the degree value given.
